hypothesis: JUXTAPOSE can learn solely from naturally executed exact proof-search pivots while solving every encountered training CNF, with ZERO extra exact training label probes, and reduce total source-exact search work relative to static, random and historical actively trained JUXTAPOSE.
original_source_manifest: Commit manifest of 120 future original-CNF source SHA before any evaluation; all training and test originals must remain disjoint
passive_update: Only previously verified exact source-proof outcomes encountered while naturally searching training cases. No separate label requests and no learning from future or test labels.
active_reference: For each training case, attempt 2 source-only preselected pivots beyond needed natural search, charging only distinct extra proofs plus complete train search.
model: count-based shrinkage per source structural bucket, no neural network and no Markov transition state
passive_cost_aware_score: ((hits+1)/(tested+4) * tested/(tested+4) + geometry_prior * (4/(tested+4)))/sqrt(1+pair_work), source-only candidate features and empirical counts; geometry_prior=0.25 for eligible, 0 for ineligible
passive_history_score: (hits+1)/(count+2) plus original JUXTAPOSE structural priority, never use numeric pivot IDs as learning feature
cost_only_score: eligible first then lowest source parent clause-pair work with fixed source-only tie-break
validation: exact bounded original-CNF resolution DAG replay and GF2 rank delta vs independently computed UP+sign-mask XOR; no unsupported width accepted; exact model SAT replay all original clauses; preserve negative/abstain
metrics: all exact probes in full training search+extra labels+frozen test
all verified outcomes and source SHA
size and SHA of accumulated memory
predeclared_acceptance: PASS only if PASSIVE_COST_AWARE has same verified first-hit coverage as every control, strictly fewer total train+test exact probes AND pair-work than STATIC_NUMERIC and ACTIVE_TWO_LABELS_REFERENCE in ALL FOUR seeds, and same-source counts, memory SHA reproducible across two independent same-SHA CI jobs; also report any failures
source_data_independence: same-admin synthetic, not external SAT Competition holdout
